theater: 亞美尼亞、卡拉巴赫與裏海東岸

battle.name: 奧斯曼-波斯戰爭 (1821年-1823年)
battle.theater: 亞美尼亞、卡拉巴赫與裏海東岸
battle.brief: 一八二一年波斯王儲阿巴斯米爾扎進攻喬治亞、圍困第比利斯，奧斯曼帝國乘勢自卡爾斯與巴格達兩面東進，一八二二年六月大軍圍攻艾里溫，砲火加坑道破城，七月二十六日城陷；一八二三年間俄軍取得爾本特、奧軍攻陷巴庫，波斯退守大不里士。攻城重砲主導戰局，卡面這件燧發槍只是守軍與步兵的骨幹。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是奧斯曼帝國與卡扎爾波斯。奧斯曼方面以伊斯坦布爾的中央政府為樞紐，野戰骨幹是正在整軍的禁軍新軍（尼讚），加上自安納托利亞、魯梅利亞與巴格達各省抽調的省軍，由伊斯坦布爾任命的帥師統一節制；一八二二年攻艾里溫的部隊以巴格達與埃爾祖魯姆兩支軍團為主，另有受雇的克里米亞韃靼騎兵與歐洲工程官、砲手隨軍。帝國在高加索的聯防由卡爾斯、阿哈爾齊赫與阿哈爾卡萊基三座要塞構成的三角線，攻勢自卡爾斯沿阿拉克斯河谷向東推進，糧秣由埃爾祖魯姆與卡爾斯分批前運，冬季軍隊退入要塞過冬。波斯一方是卡扎爾王朝，朝廷在德黑蘭，西線陪都與兵站設在大不里士，亞塞拜疆與阿拉拉特一線由王儲阿巴斯米爾扎總督；野戰骨幹是「圖凡奇」火槍步兵與各省土邦兵，騎兵用吉蘭、呼羅珊與喀什的馬匹，火槍是英國與俄國輸入的燧發線槍與成批舊式火繩槍混編，火砲則以銅鑄的輕型野砲為數十門，攻城時靠城牆、壕溝與反坑道彌補火力不足。第三方並非旁觀：俄羅斯自一八一三年《古利斯坦條約》後佔有高加索，一八二一年波斯軍圍攻第比利斯，迫使俄國放下疑慮與奧斯曼臨時聯手；英國則在德黑蘭與君士坦丁堡之間同時售槍與調解，讓戰局始終帶著外交的計算。
countriesEn: The two parties in this war were the Ottoman Empire and Qajar Persia. On the Ottoman side the centre was the central government in Istanbul; the core of the field army was the guard infantry being reformed (the nizam), supplemented by provincial levies drawn from Anatolia, Rumelia and the Baghdad eyalet, all placed under a serasker appointed from Istanbul. The force that besieged Erivan in 1822 was built mainly out of the Baghdad and Erzurum corps, with hired Crimean Tatar horse and European engineers and gunners serving alongside. The empire's line in the Caucasus was a triangle of fortresses — Kars, Akhaltsikhe and Akhalkalaki — and the advance pushed east from Kars along the valley of the Aras, with food and ammunition sent forward in batches from Erzurum and Kars, the army going into the fortresses to winter. On the Persian side stood the Qajar dynasty, with the court at Tehran and the western capital and its magazines at Tabriz; Azerbaijan and the Aras line were under the crown prince Abbas Mirza. The field core was the tufanchi, the musket infantry, together with the tribal levies of the provinces; the horse came from Gilan, Khorasan and Kashgar; the muskets were a mixture of flintlock pieces bought from Britain and Russia and large quantities of older matchlocks, and the artillery amounted to a few dozen light bronze guns, the defenders making up for their shortage of firepower with walls, ditches and counter-mines. The third party was no spectator: Russia, holding the greater part of the Caucasus since the Treaty of Gulistan of 1813, was forced by the Persian siege of Tiflis in 1821 to set aside its suspicions and act in concert with the Ottomans; and Britain sold muskets to Persia while mediating in Constantinople, so that diplomacy was woven through the whole campaign.
people: 主帥是巴格達的穆罕默德帕夏，他以「帥師」身分領軍：此前他剛在埃及打退穆罕默德·阿里的第一次入侵，一八二一年冬率兵越過阿拉克斯河，一八二二年六月圍攻艾里溫，一八二三年又沿裏海東岸打到巴庫，攻城與野戰都由他一人指揮。波斯方面的守將是亞塞拜疆總督易卜拉欣汗·哈利勒，這位以火炮與壕溝守城的將領把三重城牆與哈茲丹河的天險用到最後，卻在攻城砲火與坑道面前耗盡了時間，一八二二年七月二十六日交出艾里溫後被召回德黑蘭、撤去官職。真正決定戰略節奏的是王儲阿巴斯米爾扎：他一八二一年率軍進入喬治亞、圍困第比利斯，被俄羅斯與喬治亞聯軍擊退；其後他率主力北上救援艾里溫，卻因山路與後方受制而遲到，目睹城池淪陷乃退回大不里士，此後再未回東山再起。朝廷裡最被指責的是大維齊爾阿拉亞爾汗：圍城期間他正在君士坦丁堡交涉，被守軍指為坐視救援，一八二五年被免職；接手收拾局面的是外交大臣米爾扎·阿布勒哈桑汗·伊爾奇，他與奧斯曼談成停戰，又出任亞塞拜疆總督，後來成為一八二八年《土庫曼恰條約》的波斯全權代表之一。俄方則有葉爾莫洛夫奪取得爾本特、帕斯凱維奇代表俄國與奧斯曼磋商戰利品分配；喬治亞方面則有索洛門王公率領的民兵與俄羅斯部隊一同作戰。
peopleEn: The commander was Mehmed Pasha of Baghdad, who led as serasker: he had just defeated Muhammad Ali's first invasion of Egypt in 1821, crossed the Aras in the winter of that year, besieged Erivan in June 1822 and marched along the Caspian shore to Baku in 1823, directing both the siege operations and the field fighting himself. On the Persian side the defender was Ebrahim Khan Khalil, governor of Azerbaijan, who used the triple line of walls and the river Hrazdan to the last and ran out of time against the siege guns and the saps, and was recalled to Tehran and stripped of his command after handing over Erivan on 26 July 1822. The one who set the strategic rhythm was the crown prince Abbas Mirza: in 1821 he led his army into Georgia and besieged Tiflis, and was repulsed by a combined Russian and Georgian force; he then marched north with the main body to relieve Erivan, but the mountain roads and the pressure on his rear slowed him, and when he arrived the city was already lost, so he fell back to Tabriz and never took the offensive in the east again. The man most blamed at court was the grand vizier Allah-Yar Khan: he was in Constantinople negotiating while the city fell, was accused by the garrison of watching the relief fail, and was dismissed in 1825. The man who took over the wreckage was the foreign minister Mirza Abolhassan Khan Ilchi, who negotiated a truce with the Ottomans, was made governor of Azerbaijan, and later became one of the Persian plenipotentiaries at the Treaty of Turkmenchay of 1828. On the Russian side Yermolov took Derbent and Paskevich negotiated the division of the spoils with the Ottomans; on the Georgian side Prince Solomon led the militia that fought alongside Russian troops.
kits: 卡面這件燧發槍是十八世紀初以後歐洲與西亞所有野戰步兵的標準兵器：擊錘打擊燧石引火，既不怕風吹濕氣，又能在數百步外保持精度，一支受訓的步兵每分鐘可發三至四發，線形橫列的齊射密度全靠它撐住。一八二一至一八二三年間，奧斯曼禁軍新軍裝備的正是帶刺刀的燧發線槍，以縱隊與橫隊交替作戰；跟在新軍後面的各省省軍卻仍大量使用火繩槍，火繩浸油、遇雨即熄，遇大霧天氣便廢了一半。攻艾里溫的攻城軍除步卒外，另有數十門銅鑄野砲與攻城重砲，配備實心彈與燔石榴彈，並由歐洲工程官主持平行壕、進逼坑道與地雷爆破，突擊時以雲梯攀上塞拉城堡。波斯守軍的火槍隊以英國輸出的燧發線槍與土製火繩槍混編，射擊精度尚可而射速不齊；火炮只有十餘門輕型野砲，全靠城牆與哈茲丹河遮蔽，並在壕溝下挖反坑道對付奧斯曼的地雷。大不里士兵工廠仍能鑄造火砲與炮彈，卻因銅料仰給高加索礦山而受限，這正是此戰後波斯火砲產能長期困窘的根源。馬匹方面，奧斯曼靠安納托利亞與美索不達米亞的輜馬、克里米亞的韃靼馬，波斯靠吉蘭與呼羅珊的馬；糧食、柴薪與攻城器材靠牛車、駱駝與驢隊走卡爾斯—阿哈爾齊赫—艾里溫的內陸路線輸送。
kitsEn: The flintlock musket on this card was the standard arm of every field infantry in Europe and West Asia from the early eighteenth century onwards: the hammer struck the flint to spark the priming, so the weapon did not care about wind or damp, and it kept its accuracy at several hundred paces; a drilled infantryman could get off three or four rounds a minute, and the density of a linear volley depended entirely on it. Between 1821 and 1823 the reformed Ottoman guard infantry (the nizam) carried precisely these flintlock muskets with bayonets, fighting in column and line in turn; the provincial levies that followed them still used matchlocks by the thousand, and a matchlock with a soaked slow-match went out at once in rain and was half useless in fog. The besieging army at Erivan had, besides its infantry, several dozen light bronze field guns and heavier siege pieces firing solid shot and grapeshot, and European engineers directed the parallels, the saps and the mining of the walls, with scaling ladders and assault pioneers going up to the citadel at the storm. The Persian musketeers were a mixed body of flintlocks bought from Britain and home-made matchlocks — accuracy fair, rate of fire uneven; the artillery was a dozen or so light field guns, all covered by the walls and the Hrazdan, with counter-mines dug under the Ottoman trenches to meet the sappers underground, and the defence held out for more than forty days. The Tabriz arsenal could still cast guns and shot, but it was limited by copper that had to come from the mines of the Caucasus, and that was the root of the long trouble Persian gunnery ran into after this war. In the matter of horses the Ottomans drew on Anatolia and Mesopotamia, with Crimean Tatar horse, and the Persians on Gilan and Khorasan; grain, firewood and siege stores travelled by ox-cart, camel and mule along the inland road from Kars through Akhaltsikhe to Erivan.
tactics: 奧斯曼的攻城有一套固定程序：先以騎兵與輕步兵封鎖目標的交通線，再用大隊步兵在城外挖三道平行壕，每道壕溝之間留出守軍反擊的可乘之機，然後逐段向前推進進逼坑道，在壕溝盡頭的地雷把城牆炸開缺口，最後以梯隊與工兵突入。1822年的艾里溫是三重城牆環繞哈茲丹河、另有塞拉城堡的複合要塞，攻城軍必須連破三道城牆。封鎖同樣是戰役的一部分：巴格達與埃爾祖魯姆兩路兵馬一南一北夾住大不里士—艾里溫的交通，韃靼騎兵在周邊劫掠糧車，波斯援軍因而無法接近。守軍的戰術是以守代攻：火槍手依托城垛射擊坑道中的工兵，以出擊部隊夜襲壕溝、拆毀支架企圖拖慢進逼速度，再以反坑道在地下迎擊對方的地雷，拖了四十餘日。阿巴斯米爾扎的救援軍隊本應以攻擊攻城軍側翼與補給線為任務，卻因翻越阿拉拉特山口的積雪與俄軍切斷後方而行動遲緩，等他趕到時城池已失。1823年俄軍轉而用同樣的封鎖思路奇襲得爾本特，從北方切斷波斯在裏海的交通；同年七月奧斯曼軍再以艦船與陸路配合封住巴庫港，攻城全靠砲火。季節是第三方參戰者：1821至1822年冬的高加索嚴寒使遠征軍大量病亡，1822年夏的酷熱又令攻城兵疲於壕溝，天氣往往比任何一次砲擊更決定進度。
tacticsEn: The Ottomans had a fixed procedure for taking a fortress: first the cavalry and light infantry would cut the roads that fed the place, then the massed infantry dug three lines of parallels outside the walls, leaving between each line a gap the garrison could use to counter-attack, and from there the saps were pushed forward trench by trench, until a mine at the end of the sap blew a breach in the wall, and the storming columns and pioneers went in through it. Erivan in 1822 was a composite fortress — three lines of walls around the river Hrazdan, with the citadel above them — so the besiegers had to break through three separate walls. The blockade was part of the battle in its own right: the Baghdad and Erzurum columns pinched the Tabriz–Erivan road from the south and the north, and Tatar horse stripped the food convoys on the edges of the field, so that a relief army could not get close. The defence was fought as a holding action: musketeers fired from the parapets at the sappers in the trench, sortie parties came out at night to break the fascines and stall the advance, and counter-mines were driven under the enemy saps to meet their miners underground, which held the besiegers off for more than forty days. The relief force under Abbas Mirza was supposed to work on the flank of the besiegers and on their supply road, but the snow on the Aras passes and the Russians cutting his rear slowed him so far that the city was gone before he came up. In 1823 the Russians turned the same logic of blockade on Derbent and took it by surprise from the north, cutting Persia off from the Caspian; in July of the same year the Ottomans sealed Baku's harbour from the land and the sea and took the city by bombardment alone. The season was a third combatant: the severe winter of 1821–1822 in the Caucasus killed off much of the expeditionary army by cold and disease, and the heat of the summer of 1822 wore the besiegers down in the trenches; the weather settled more of the timetable than any single bombardment.
data: 留下數字的只有零散的戰報與使節報告，須分辨真偽。攻城方兵力：波斯與俄方記載稱奧斯曼在艾里溫城下有三萬至四萬人，火砲數十門；奧斯曼自己的清冊也承認遠征軍出發時已逾三萬，另有受雇的克里米亞騎兵數千。守軍：易卜拉欣汗所部約四千人上下，火砲十餘門，其中多為可以移動的輕型野砲。圍城自一八二二年六月打到七月二十六日陷落，歷時約四十至五十日，攻城軍在壕溝與火線下的減員不詳。時間點：得爾本特一八二三年二月六日落入俄軍之手，巴庫同年七月二十六日被奧斯曼軍攻陷。距離：卡爾斯至艾里溫約二百五十公里，阿哈爾齊赫至戰線約一百八十公里，巴格達經摩蘇爾到前線超過一千公里，大不里士至艾里溫約三百公里。產能與馬力：大不里士兵工廠仍能鑄造火砲與炮彈，但銅料仰給高加索礦山，一八二三年後失去亞塞拜疆即告斷源；波斯的線槍總數以萬計，其中英國式燧發槍佔比有限，舊式火繩槍仍佔多數，軍中由英籍顧問訓練的縱隊不過數千人。傷亡方面無可靠統計，雙方戰報都有誇大，攻城軍在高加索冬季因嚴寒與疫病減員尤重，一八二二年冬生還人數遠低於出發人數，但確切數字無從考證。卡面那件一七一〇年的燧發槍在數字上沒有可比的記録：它決定的是每分鐘的發射數與單發命中率，而非戰役的規模。
dataEn: Only scattered despatches and consular reports carry figures, and they must be read with care. On the besieger's strength: Persian and Russian accounts put the Ottomans below Erivan at thirty to forty thousand men with several dozen guns, and the Ottoman returns themselves put the expeditionary force above thirty thousand even before it set out, with several thousand hired Crimean riders besides. On the defence: Ebrahim Khan's command was around four thousand men with a dozen or so light field guns, most of them mobile. The siege ran from June 1822 to the fall of the city on 26 July, some forty to fifty days, and the losses of the besiegers in the trenches and under the guns are not recorded. The fixed points in time: Derbent fell to the Russians on 6 February 1823, and Baku was taken by the Ottomans on 26 July of that year. Distances: about 250 kilometres from Kars to Erivan, some 180 kilometres from Akhaltsikhe to the lines, over a thousand kilometres from Baghdad through Mosul to the front, and around 300 kilometres from Tabriz to Erivan. In production and in horse: the Tabriz arsenal could still cast guns and shot, but its copper came from the mines of the Caucasus, and the loss of Azerbaijan after 1823 cut the supply off at source; the Persians had muskets by the tens of thousands, but only a limited share were British flintlocks while old matchlocks remained the majority, and the columns trained by the British instructors numbered only a few thousand men. On losses there is no reliable count; both sides' reports exaggerate, and the besiegers lost heavily to cold and disease in the Caucasian winter, so that far fewer men came through the winter of 1822 than had gone into it, though the exact figures cannot be established. As for the flintlock musket of 1710 on the card, it has no comparable figure to offer: what it decided was the rate of fire per minute and the hit rate of a single shot, not the scale of the campaign.
cause: 打起上來有兩層根由。外層是一八二一年夏的直接軍事衝突：阿巴斯米爾扎率軍越過庫拉河進入喬治亞，圍困第比利斯，試圖在俄國尚未完全控制南高加索時取下這個節點；圍城失敗後，波斯軍轉向德爾本特與希爾萬的沙赫領地，而這些沙赫同時向君士坦丁堡求援，奧斯曼帝國便以援助屬國、保護邊境教民為名出兵，戰爭自此全面化。內層是三十多年來未了的高加索爭端：一六三九年《祖哈布條約》把亞塞拜疆、亞美尼亞與喬治亞一線劃給波斯，奧斯曼自此視南高加索為失地，卡爾斯—阿哈爾齊赫—艾里溫一線始終是帝國的安全地帶；而俄羅斯在一八一三年《古利斯坦條約》後取得高加索大部分地區，正往波斯邊境與裏海推進，使奧斯曼與波斯在「誰來擋住俄國」這一點上有了共同利益。波斯的目標也不止國土：南高加索是卡扎爾王朝的兵源與兵工銅料來源，失去它，新造的線槍與火砲就失去原料；對奧斯曼而言，蘇丹馬哈茂德二世一八二一年剛在埃及擊敗穆罕默德·阿里，地中海方面暫時無事，正是把兵力東調的時機，而英國樂見衝突局限在山區，不願它牽動東地中海的商路。
causeEn: There were two layers behind the fighting. The outer one is the direct military collision of the summer of 1821: Abbas Mirza crossed the Kura into Georgia and besieged Tiflis, trying to take that hinge before Russia had fully mastered the southern Caucasus; when the siege failed, the Persian army turned towards the khanates of Derbent and Shirvan, whose khans were at the same time appealing to Constantinople, and the Ottoman Empire went to war on the pretext of supporting those vassals and protecting the religious communities on its frontier, and from that moment the war became general. The inner layer is the old Caucasian quarrel left unsettled for three decades: the Treaty of Zuhab of 1639 had assigned Azerbaijan, Armenia and the Georgian line to Persia, and the Ottomans had regarded the southern Caucasus as lost territory ever since, with the Kars–Akhaltsikhe–Erivan line always the empire's security zone; and after the Treaty of Gulistan of 1813 Russia held most of the Caucasus and was pressing towards the Persian frontier and the Caspian, which gave Ottomans and Persians a common interest in the one question of who would stop Russia. The Persian object was not only territory: the southern Caucasus was the Qajar dynasty's reservoir of manpower and of copper for its foundries, and without it the new muskets and guns had no raw material; and for the Ottomans, the sultan Mahmud II had just beaten Muhammad Ali in Egypt in 1821, the Mediterranean was quiet for the time being, and that was the moment to shift troops east, while Britain was glad to see the fighting kept in the mountains and did not want it to disturb the trade of the eastern Mediterranean.
impact: 此役的後果超出高加索本身。波斯在亞塞拜疆的統治崩解，一八二六年它不得不與俄國結盟對付奧斯曼，一八二八年《土庫曼恰條約》把南高加索正式割讓給俄羅斯，卡扎爾王朝就此失去最主要的兵源、稅源與兵工銅料，國家財政此後常年入不敷出，十九世紀中葉的改革努力與一八四八年憲章運動都建立在這個削弱的基礎上。外溢的影響還有兩條：一是1821年米爾扎·卡伊姆汗與阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·加福里逃往俄屬高加索，開始在境外鼓吹反對卡扎爾王朝，這場「希吉拉特」流亡運動成為近代波斯知識分子離散與歐化改革的源頭；二是北高加索的穆林居民在戰亂與隨後的俄羅斯推進中大批南遷安納托利亞，契爾克斯等社群自此在帝國西部安家，與一八二七年加齊·穆罕默德在高加索建立伊馬國、演成高加索戰爭的長期抗爭一齊構成本世紀末東方的亂局。奧斯曼這邊短期收回艾里溫與裏海東岸的堡壘，卻在一八二八至一八二九年的俄土戰爭中於喬治亞失利，被《阿德里安堡條約》逐出高加索，得而復失；真正留下的是制度層面的經驗——歐洲工程官主持的攻城術、制式野砲與新整的砲兵，使帝國此後的攻城作戰與火砲制度逐漸擺脫舊式雇傭兵的散漫。
impactEn: The consequences ran well beyond the Caucasus itself. Persian rule in Azerbaijan collapsed, and in 1826 Qajar Iran had to ally with Russia against the Ottomans; the Treaty of Turkmenchay of 1828 handed the southern Caucasus to Russia in full, and the Qajar state thereby lost its chief source of men, of taxes and of foundry copper, with the treasury in chronic deficit for the rest of the century, so that the reform efforts of the mid-nineteenth century and the Constitutional Movement of 1848 both grew out of this weakened base. Two further spillovers matter: in 1821 Mirza Qa'em Khan and Abdol-Rahman Gha'fori fled to Russian Georgia and began preaching against the Qajar dynasty from abroad, and this hejrat, the movement of exile, became the fountainhead of the modern Persian diaspora and of Westernising reform; and the Muslim communities of the north Caucasian mountains moved south in their thousands during the war and the Russian advance that followed, settling in Anatolia, where the Circassian and other communities took root in the western empire, while the resistance in Dagestan led to Gazi Muhammad founding the Caucasian Imamate in 1827 and to the long Caucasian War that marked the close of the century. The Ottomans recovered Erivan and the Caspian littoral fortresses in the short term, but lost Georgia in the Russo-Ottoman War of 1828–1829 and were driven out of the Caucasus by the Treaty of Adrianople, winning and losing the same ground within a few years. What actually remained was institutional: the siegecraft of the European engineers, the standardised field guns and the re-formed artillery carried Ottoman siege practice and the gun service gradually out of the loose habits of the old mercenary system.
result: 結果是波斯在戰場上完敗：1822年7月26日艾里溫陷落，1823年2月6日得爾本特落入俄軍之手，同年7月26日巴庫被奧斯曼軍攻陷，波斯在亞塞拜疆與達吉斯坦沿海的行政機構瓦解，國政退守大不里士，一八二一年以來阿巴斯米爾扎在西北線的努力全數作廢。戰事沒有以一份像樣的和約收束，雙方靠事實上的停火維持，而真正的裁決留給了俄國——1827年阿巴斯米爾扎一度奪回艾里溫，1828年俄軍再取該城，奧斯曼守軍撤出，高加索的歸屬在《土庫曼恰條約》中定案。對卡面這件兵器可以確定的只有一點：燧發槍在此役中不決定任何一場勝負。決定艾里溫陷落的是攻城重砲的射程、坑道與地雷的進度，以及封鎖線切斷了外援；燧發槍的作用在別處——它讓城頭的射擊更精準，讓攻城壕溝裡的工兵不敢抬頭，讓開闊地上的線形齊射維持密度，而在巴庫城下，它又成為守軍在砲火之下唯一能連續射擊的手段。
resultEn: The result was a complete Persian defeat in the field: Erivan fell on 26 July 1822, Derbent went to the Russians on 6 February 1823, and Baku was taken by the Ottomans on 26 July of that year; the Persian administration in Azerbaijan and along the Dagestani coast fell apart, the government drew back to Tabriz, and everything Abbas Mirza had built on the north-western front since 1821 was wasted. The war was not closed by any proper treaty; the two sides held on an armed truce, and the real settlement was left to Russia — Abbas Mirza recovered Erivan for a moment in 1827, the Russians took it again in 1828, the Ottoman garrison withdrew, and the fate of the Caucasus was fixed in the Treaty of Turkmenchay. As for the weapon on the card, only one thing can be said with certainty: the flintlock musket decided no battle in this war. What brought Erivan down was the reach of the siege guns, the pace of the saps and the mines, and the blockade that cut off the relief; the musket's work was elsewhere — it made the fire from the parapets more accurate, kept the pioneers in the trenches from raising their heads, held the density of the linear volley in the open, and at Baku it was the only weapon the garrison could keep firing in bursts under the guns.
